entries.description: orders fail: failed to charge card
one product's page, recommendations that include it and orders containing it fail
entries.notes: recommendation only lists products and is not affected (decision 010 rule 3)

entries.description: every order fails: the payment dependency cannot be reached
entries.notes: checkout dials a wrong payment address (decision 016 origin rule); payment is healthy and only stops receiving charges, so it is not affected; shipping, email, kafka consumers get less traffic

entries.description: orders still succeed; carts are not emptied after an order
entries.notes: cart's own second store points at a bad host; valkey-cart is healthy. The time a failed EmptyCart takes is not known a priori: if it is seconds or more, checkout and the edge slow down or time out, and review records it (decision 016)

entries.description: orders shipped outside the US take about 10 s longer
entries.notes: only Locust orders to the one non-US address are slowed: about 3 in 10 minutes (decision 016 exercised rule)

entries.description: product pages, recommendations and orders hang behind a table lock; some time out
entries.notes: product-catalog's own code holds the lock; astronomy-db's connection and rollback counts change but it shows no errors or latency of its own (decision 016 rule 3 clarification)
busy-loop threads in ad; with the machine's spare CPU the ads call is not expected to slow down
repeated full collections on every ads call; heap pressure may outlast the fault
email memory grows about 2 MB per message to an OOM restart (about 6-8 minutes in); the confirmation send that hits the restart fails in checkout, which does not fail the order

entries.description: recommendations slow down and fail while the service restarts
entries.notes: the cache list grows on every miss until OOM restarts (a few in 10 minutes); memory is not freed when the fault ends
